name: Agent Venom

abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.

signatureAbility:
Klyntar Rage
At the beginning of the fight, and whenever Flash loses 50% of his Max Health, he temporarily loses control of the Venom symbiote, increasing Attack by [323.36 - 989.92]. This effect is lost once he is struck 5 times.
While under Klyntar Rage, Flash also gains [36.59 - 115.89] Critical Damage Rating.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Flash's intense military background, coupled with the alien symbiotic enhancement, grants him a 70% chance to Purify any Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: The Venom Symbiote works with Flash's training to reduce enemy Evasion chance by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: 65% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [8,892.4] Direct Damage over 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: This attack reduces enemy Evasion chance by 30%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: This attack Incinerates the enemy, dealing [4,042] Energy Damage over 8.5 seconds. This effect also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50% while it's active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Any Bleed effect has an additional 25% chance to trigger.
